reproduction_python:
import json
import time
from engineering.design_engine.runtime import Manager, TERMINAL
report = json.load(open('docs/design-engine/review-model-verification.json'))
job = next(row for row in report['jobs'] if row['label'] == 'civil-current-screen-for-native-correspondence')
adapter = job['adapter']
request = dict(job['request'], dependencies={**report['source_dependencies_common'], **report['source_dependencies_by_adapter'][adapter]}, toolchain=report['toolchains'][adapter])
manager = Manager('build/consolidation/reproduced-review-jobs')
launched = manager.start(request)
while manager.store.get(launched['id'])['status'] not in TERMINAL: time.sleep(0.2)
print(manager.store.get(launched['id'])['status'])
